prompt: List the name of each student with the title of every course they are enrolled in.
answerSql:
SELECT s.name, c.title
FROM enrollments e
JOIN students s ON s.id = e.student_id
JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id;
hiddenDataSql:
INSERT INTO students VALUES (5, 'Ella Tan', 'BSIT');
INSERT INTO enrollments VALUES (5, 2), (4, 3);

prompt: Show each course title and how many students are enrolled in it, including courses with no students. Most students first; break ties by title A–Z.
answerSql:
SELECT c.title, COUNT(e.student_id) AS enrolled
FROM courses c
LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON e.course_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id
ORDER BY enrolled DESC, c.title;
hiddenDataSql:
INSERT INTO courses VALUES (5, 'IT305', 'Networking');
INSERT INTO enrollments VALUES (2, 2), (4, 2), (4, 4);
rubric: LEFT JOIN so empty courses show 0; COUNT a column from enrollments, not *.
